author: reek
body: Persistence wrapper around AnnotationDriver. On init, loads annotations, proposals, and verdicts from DiskFacts (kinds 35-37). On every mutation (annotate, publish, accept, reject, incoming proposal/verdict), persists the new record back to DiskFacts. The AnnotationDriver handles the in-memory state; this layer handles durability.

author: reek
body: Follows the browser opening pattern: a composite state record carrying both the driver and the DiskFactStore, with each operation updating both.
